summary: syrp-events (increment 3): the macOS CFRunLoop backend (run-loop source for wakes, a non-coalesced kqueue timer surfaced as a CFFileDescriptor, delivery also under a foreign run-loop driver) and the Windows message-only-window backend (PostMessageW wake, MsgWaitForMultipleObjectsEx timeouts at 1 ms resolution, other windows' messages translated and dispatched), replacing the interim backends.
